subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Should this PR remain blocked until current-head live or proof-stack evidence shows the generated-media wake-false fallback, or should maintainers explicitly accept the scheduler tests plus skipped internal-path Mantis manifest as sufficient proof?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot safely convert a skipped Mantis manifest into sufficient real behavior proof for an external message-delivery PR without maintainer intent, even though the code shape appears sound.

options.title: Require Live Or Proof-Stack Evidence
options.body: Keep the PR proof-gated until a redacted Telegram/channel artifact, terminal live output, or linked proof-stack run shows the fallback delivering the generated media exactly once.

options.title: Accept Scheduler Boundary Proof
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally override the real-behavior gate and accept the focused scheduler matrix plus internal Mantis manifest for this hard-to-trigger path.

options.title: Pause Behind Proof Harness
options.body: Keep this implementation draft paused until the separate proof harness or stacked draft produces a single baseline/candidate proof story.

recommendation.title: Require Live Or Proof-Stack Evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the PR proof-gated until a redacted Telegram/channel artifact, terminal live output, or linked proof-stack run shows the fallback delivering the generated media exactly once.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about media direct-delivery proof sufficiency, and steipete has adjacent history in the async media direct-delivery path.
